game.title: Darksiders Genesis
game.blurb: Top-down action adventure in which the Horsemen War and Strife hunt the Lords of Hell, from Airship Syndicate, released 2019-12-05. RAWG average playtime: 4 hours. Genres: Action, Adventure, RPG. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: The Main Story and the Lords of Hell
chapters.summary: The 17 levels and the bosses Mammon, Belial, Astarte, Dagon and Moloch. Spoiler-guarded where hidden.

chapters.title: Level Challenges
chapters.summary: Optional goals inside levels such as The Slag Pit, Icebind Cavern, Decay, Bastion's Fall and War Machine.

chapters.title: War and Strife
chapters.summary: Learning every Wrath ability, Strife's elemental ammo and War's elemental enhancements.

chapters.title: Coins, Cores and Trickster Doors
chapters.summary: Boatman Coins, creature cores, the Boatman's Labyrinth and Trickster Doors.

chapters.title: Arena and Harder Difficulties
chapters.summary: A high arena score and finishing every level on Hard and Apocalyptic.

notes: Backlog game, picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year (docs/PLAN.md section 2 ordering). StrategyWiki has a stub page (completion stage 0); its Walkthrough, Gameplay, Controls and "Achievements and trophies" subpages are linked but not written, and only a short "Table of Contents" (about 350 characters) exists, so nothing was used. darksiders.fandom.com answers the API, with about 32 linked pages, including "Mammon", "Belial", "Astarte", "Dagon", "Moloch", "Strife" and "War"; names only were looked at, nothing copied. 6 of 30 Steam achievements are hidden. Four of them ("Belial", "Astarte", "Dagon", "Moloch") follow the visible "Mammon" (defeat Mammon, Lord of Hell) and share names with Fandom pages, so the boss names in the chapter summary come from there; they sit in the main story chapter. The other two hidden ones, "Blademaster" and "Wicked Killington", also sit there as placeholders. RAWG lists a playtime of only 4 hours, which looks low.
